projects.title: VehicleChain
projects.tagline: Blockchain vehicle service, warranty and dispute platform.
projects.description: Blockchain-backed vehicle service and warranty management platform for the Malaysian automotive market: tamper-proof service records, multi-party on-chain verification, real-time push notifications, and independently verifiable warranty status.

projects.title: MilanSoftware
projects.tagline: Quotation platform built for a real business workflow.
projects.description: Soft furnishings order system for a Malaysian retailer (MilanDecor): a Flutter quoting app, a FastAPI backend and one shared pricing contract. Next up: floor plan recognition, AI workflows and LLM integration.

projects.title: Smart Inventory
projects.tagline: RFID and IoT supply-chain tracker with an LLM assistant.
projects.description: AI-driven, LLM-based assistant smart inventory management system. ESP32 and RC522 readers publish over MQTT to a Flask backend with a tag state machine, a live SSE dashboard, and ML-backed analytics.
